name_zh: 罗马尼亚·尼古拉·齐奥塞斯库：独裁体操与革命处决
name_en: Romania Nicolae Ceausescu: Dictatorship Gymnastics & Revolution Execution
description_zh: 尼古拉·齐奥塞斯库 (1918-1989) 罗马尼亚共产党总书记 (1965-1989)，建立个人崇拜与家族统治，推行体操外交展示国家形象，1989年革命中被速审枪决，结束东欧最后斯大林主义政权。
description_en: Nicolae Ceausescu (1918-1989) Romanian Communist Party General Secretary (1965-1989), built personality cult and family rule, conducted gymnastics diplomacy showcasing national image, 1989 revolution tried and executed, ending Eastern Europe last Stalinist regime.
reason_zh: 齐奥塞斯库代表东欧斯大林主义最极端形式，展示了个人崇拜、体操外交、秘密警察如何维系极权控制，其暴力倒台标志东欧剧变终局。
reason_en: Ceausescu represents Eastern European Stalinism most extreme form, demonstrating how personality cult, gymnastics diplomacy, secret police maintain totalitarian control, his violent overthrow marked Eastern European revolutions finale.
steps_zh: 研究齐奥塞斯库早年共产党地下活动与格奥尔基乌-德治继任
分析个人崇拜体系与埃莱娜家族权力分配
探讨体操外交与纳迪亚·科马内奇国家形象建设
评估1989年蒂米什瓦拉爆发与布加勒斯特革命速审枪决
总结齐奥塞斯库遗产对罗马尼亚转型正义与记忆政治影响
steps_en: Study Ceausescu early Communist underground and Gheorghiu-Dej succession
Analyze personality cult system and Elena family power distribution
Explore gymnastics diplomacy and Nadia Comaneci national image building
Evaluate 1989 Timisoara outbreak and Bucharest revolution summary execution
Summarize Ceausescu legacy for Romanian transitional justice and memory politics
expected_zh: 理解斯大林主义极权体制的内部运作逻辑与崩溃机制，掌握体操外交作为软实力工具的独特性，评估其对罗马尼亚后共产主义转型的深远创伤。
expected_en: Understand Stalinist totalitarian system internal logic and collapse mechanism, grasp gymnastics diplomacy uniqueness as soft power tool, evaluate its profound trauma for Romanian post-communist transition.
case_zh: 1965 齐奥塞斯库掌权；1974 总统制确立；1989 12月革命爆发；12月25日布加勒斯特军事法庭速审枪决。独裁体操革命处决永存。
case_en: 1965 Ceausescu took power; 1974 presidency established; 1989 Dec revolution erupted; Dec 25 Bucharest military tribunal summary execution. Dictatorship gymnastics revolution execution endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Stalinism extreme form; gymnastics diplomacy; violent overthrow; transitional justice
